story.iWant: a dashboard tab showing ETL metrics and system health
story.soThat: I can visualize system performance and identify issues
story.tasks: - Create new tab src/web/dashboard/components/metrics_tab.py - Use dash-bootstrap-components Table for metrics display - Use Plotly for time-series charts - Load data from data/metrics/ directory - Implement MetricsManager class following VideoManager pattern - Add single callback for source selection and error log drill-down

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given metrics data exists from Story 1.1, when I navigate to the "Metrics" dashboard tab, then I see a table of all ETL sources with: name, last run time, items processed, success rate (%), avg duration - And I see a chart showing ETL run times over the last 7 days - And I see error count per source (last 24 hours) - And failed ETLs are highlighted in red - And I can click a source to see detailed error logs

artifacts.docs: <doc path="docs/prd.md" title="Product Requirements Document" section="Success Criteria" snippet="Dashboard Performance target: Dashboard loads in <2 seconds with 1,500+ items. Page load times, interaction responsiveness. No waiting, instant domain switching."/>

artifact.reason: Data management pattern that MetricsManager should follow for loading and processing metrics data
Example of Plotly integration for time-series visualization and charts that metrics tab should use
Example of data table rendering patterns for displaying metrics in tabular format
Data model structure that metrics tab will read and visualize from stored metrics files
Main tab structure where new metrics tab needs to be registered and integrated

constraints.constraint: Metrics tab initial load time must be <2 seconds with 7 days of metrics data
Use single callback pattern to prevent "Duplicate callback outputs" errors following existing dashboard patterns
Handle missing or corrupted metrics files gracefully without breaking tab functionality
Use Bootstrap styling consistent with existing dashboard theme and color schemes
Enable click-to-drill-down functionality for error log viewing without page navigation

interface.name: MetricsManager
interface.signature: class MetricsManager: def load_data(): def get_error_counts(): def get_metrics_summary():

interface.name: TimeSeriesChart
interface.signature: plotly.graph_objects.Figure with go.Scatter for ETL duration trends

interface.name: MetricsTable
interface.signature: dash_table.DataTable with columns: source, last_run, items_processed, success_rate, avg_duration

tests.standards: Dashboard component testing using pytest with mocking of metrics data files. Plotly chart rendering tested with expected data structures. UI testing using Playwright for table interactions and error log drill-down functionality.

ideas.idea: Test: Navigate to metrics tab and verify table contains all expected columns (name, last run time, items processed, success rate %, avg duration)
Test: Verify 7-day time-series chart renders with ETL duration data and interactive tooltips
Test: Check error count accuracy by comparing displayed values with actual metrics file data
Test: Create metrics with success_rate <0.95 and verify failed ETLs are highlighted in red
Test: Click table row and verify detailed error logs are displayed in expandable section
Test: Load metrics tab with 7 days of data and verify load time <2 seconds
